queries.prompt: Walk our AgentCore project through the production hardening checklist — IAM scoping, inbound JWT auth, KMS CMK encryption, and session timeouts.
Lock down inbound authentication on our AgentCore Runtime endpoint so only our backend or Cognito `allowedAudience` callers can invoke it.
Optimize cold starts on our AgentCore Runtime (`< 100 MB` package budget and warm-pool singletons) and configure `StopRuntimeSession` lifecycle settings.
Audit `app/` for direct outbound `httpx` calls and `os.getenv` secrets before we take our agent live in `ap-south-1`.
Why do Cognito access tokens with `client_id` return HTTP 403 against `allowedAudience`, and why did our PingFederate `discoveryUrl` fail RFC 8414 issuer validation?
Plan `maxVms` session quota headroom, `idleRuntimeSessionTimeout`, and `<retrieved_memory_untrusted>` prompt-injection defenses before our 500-user launch.
AppSec blocked our AgentCore production release because our execution role still has `foundation-model/*`, no `aws:SourceAccount` trust condition, and `MCPClient` initialized at module scope.
We're going live Friday with a PCI-scoped payment support agent — verify KMS CMK requirements, input length bounds, and `InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand` isolation.
How do we keep an AgentCore microVM alive during a background job (`add_async_task`) while aggressively reclaiming idle sessions after chat end?
Author Cedar `forbid` and `permit` tool-restriction policies (`Target___tool`) on our AgentCore Gateway Policy Engine and store an outbound Jira API key.
Set up `Builtin.Faithfulness` and `@custom_code_based_evaluator` CI/CD quality gates with 2% online eval sampling in `agentcore.json`.
Wire multi-agent A2A specialist delegation on port `9000` using `StrandsA2AExecutor` and `@requires_access_token(auth_flow='M2M')`.
